law: ANY DEVICE ON THE LAN IS A CELL. A phone becomes a map. Airgap scavenger hunt. The deck is the browser.
concept: gaia-browser = mobile-first web app served by gaia-http.js at /mesh or /browser. Opens on ANY phone on LAN. Shows: LAN topology map, live pulse, RSS spine feed, paintings gallery, DOS commands. Progressive Web App (PWA) — installable. Airgap-capable once cached.

routes./mesh: LAN topology live map + device status
routes./browser: full Gaia browser — deck + mesh + feeds combined
